howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以访问 Example Engineering Blog 的 RSS 订阅源，查看文章列表、作者信息、标签分类等，并基于这些内容回答你的问题。
howto.when: 当你询问关于 Example Engineering Blog 的文章、作者或特定主题时，Claude 会使用该技能获取信息。

say.text: Example Engineering Blog 最近有哪些文章？
say.note: Claude 会列出最近的4篇文章。

say.text: Jane Doe 写了哪些文章？
say.note: Claude 会显示该作者的2篇文章。

say.text: Python 标签下有什么内容？
say.note: Claude 会查找该标签的文章。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can access the RSS feed of Example Engineering Blog, view article lists, author info, tags, etc., and answer questions based on this content.
howto.when_en: When you ask about articles, authors, or specific topics from Example Engineering Blog, Claude will use this skill to retrieve information.

say_en.text: What are the recent articles on Example Engineering Blog?
say_en.note: Claude will list the 4 most recent articles.

say_en.text: What articles did Jane Doe write?
say_en.note: Claude will show the 2 articles by that author.

say_en.text: What content is under the Python tag?
say_en.note: Claude will look up articles with that tag.
